ac-wp-translator.name: Translate
ac-wp-translator.description: AI-powered real-time translation using Anthropic Claude. URL-based language prefixes (/es/, /fr/, etc.), native-speaker B2B prompts per language, custom never-translate list and glossary, and smart caching.

ac-bulk-meta.name: Meta
ac-bulk-meta.description: AI-powered bulk SEO meta editor with FAQ generation and JSON-LD structured data.

ac-magic-links.name: Magic
ac-magic-links.description: One-click magic links for password-protected pages with usage logging and IP geolocation.

ac-static-cache.name: LockCache
ac-static-cache.description: Static HTML cache for password-protected posts with admin management and debug logging.

ac-pods.name: Pods
ac-pods.description: Podcast carousel and floating player via Apple Podcasts RSS feed or built-in custom post type.

ac-sync.name: Sync
ac-sync.description: WordPress environment sync with REST API for file, database, and media operations between production and staging.

amplifi-security.name: Security
amplifi-security.description: WordPress security with an AI brain. Local scans, Claude triage with your own API key, and alerts only on confirmed or likely findings.

ac-alt-text.name: Alt
ac-alt-text.description: AI-powered alt text for WordPress images. Bulk-generate for the existing media library and auto-generate on upload, with cost caps and daily email reports.

ac-schema.name: Schema
ac-schema.description: AI-generated schema.org JSON-LD with bulk generation, per-post editor, foreign-source detection (Yoast, Rank Math, SEOPress, AIOSEO), URL rules, and single @graph output.
